title: 1급 조사 한눈에: 누가, 어디에서, 무엇을?
objective: You can pick the right particle for a noun and use it in short sentences.
summary: A chart of the basic Korean particles, with one easy example for each.

task.title: Use the right particle
task.line: Check the meaning and the last sound of the noun (consonant or vowel), then choose, write, or fix the particle.

forms.when: After a consonant: 이. After a vowel: 가. (저 + 가 = 제가)
forms.means: Marks the subject: who or what does it, or what there is (with 있어요/없어요).
forms.exampleMeaning: I'm hungry. Is there any water?

forms.when: After a consonant: 은. After a vowel: 는.
forms.means: Marks the topic: 'as for ~'. Also used to compare two things.
forms.exampleMeaning: I'm an office worker. My younger sibling is a student.

forms.when: After a consonant: 을. After a vowel: 를.
forms.means: Marks the object: what you eat, drink, buy, see, and so on.
forms.exampleMeaning: I eat bread and drink coffee.

forms.means: ① Time: 'at, on'. ② Place you go or come to, or where something is (가요, 와요, 있어요, 없어요).
forms.exampleMeaning: I go to school at three o'clock.

forms.means: The place where an action happens: 'at, in'.

forms.when: Same form after any noun. It takes the place of 이/가, 은/는, 을/를.
와 after a vowel, 과 after a consonant (writing). 하고 after any noun. 이랑 after a consonant, 랑 after a vowel (casual talk).
forms.exampleMeaning: I bought bread and milk. I ate them with my younger sibling.

watchOut: 학교에서 가요 (X) → 학교에 가요 (O): Use 에 with 가요, 와요, 있어요, 없어요. Use 에서 with actions like 먹어요, 공부해요.
저가 (X) → 제가 (O): 저 + 가 always becomes 제가.
exercises: Choose the right particle: ① 주스(을/를) 마셔요. ② 가방(이/가) 없어요. ③ 선생님(와/과) 이야기해요. ④ 언니(은/는) 의사예요.
Write 에 or 에서: ① 주말에 공원___ 가요. ② 식당___ 점심을 먹어요. ③ 침대 위___ 고양이가 있어요. ④ 일곱 시___ 일어나요.
Find and fix the wrong particle: ① 저가 마리아예요. ② 카페에 친구를 만나요. ③ 친구도는 키가 커요.
Join the two nouns with the particle given: ① 우유 + 빵 (이랑/랑) ② 연필 + 공책 (이랑/랑) ③ 엄마 + 아빠 (하고)
answers: ① 를 ② 이 ③ 과 ④ 는
① 에 ② 에서 ③ 에 ④ 에
① 저가 → 제가 (or 저는) ② 카페에 → 카페에서 ③ 친구도는 → 친구도 (or 친구는)
① 우유랑 빵 ② 연필이랑 공책 ③ 엄마하고 아빠
